avis.titre: Its going to take weeks on aged skin.  Patience.Its going to take weeks on aged skin.  Patience.
avis.texte: Have used two of the four masks. First time the product took close to four hours to completely absorb. It felt nice, but little changed in appearance. Second time (4 days later) the absorbing timeframe was shorter but I chose to sleep in it. The appearance the next morning was noticeably improved. I intend to use this for six weeks before deciding if I will continue to invest. But after 1 week and two applications, I can say my skin feels better and looks nicer. Hoping in six week to have lost the lines that plague my mouth area, and chin. Im 69 and never did a regular skin routine, so considering that, Im impressed by the product.

avis.titre: Phenomenal.
avis.texte: Ummm this mask is phenomenal. I’ve tried several masks in the past and honestly they were nothing short of pure trash but this one is amazing. Forehead lines-gone. Frown lines-gone uneven blotchy skin tone- gone, huge pores- slammed shut, dry dull grey complection- gone. I’m only in my late 30’s and I work like a common animal 12+ hours a day 7 days a week so sometimes I look like I’m 50 no joke..This mask literally took 20 years off my face in the amount of time it took to take a nap. My skin is hydrated, glassy, smooth and looks healthy, no residue left behind and no greasy look or feel completely worth every cent. The only negative thing I could possibly say is putting it on at first Is slimy and cold and slides around on your face a bit but what do you expect. It’s wet And full of moisture. It’s not going to just cling to your face so put it on and lay down. Eventually you will feel it adhere to your face. Then you can go about your biz and forget it’s even on. This is the second time I’ve used one. The first one I had to take off after about an hour Abd a half but still saw some results. The second one I let stay on til it turned clear (about 2.5 hours) and it does what it says. So being consistent is key. I’m also a male so if anyone is wondering if it works on guys. It does. Wash your face well and dry it well. Put the mask on, lay down for a bit and let it do its thing. It’s a simple application process if you do it correctly. Will be buying more for sure

avis.titre: Woke Up to Soft, Hydrated, Glowing Skin
avis.texte: I’m new to collagen masks, but at 47 I’m always looking for products that can help keep my skin looking its best. I decided to give this mask a try, and I’m really impressed with the results. The gel mask feels cool, comfortable, and very hydrating while it’s on. When I woke up the next morning, my skin felt noticeably softer, looked well hydrated, and had a healthy glow. It made my complexion look refreshed without feeling greasy or heavy. I’m looking forward to making this part of my regular skincare routine. If you’re curious about collagen masks and want one that leaves your skin feeling moisturized, smooth, and radiant, this is a great one to try. It is very easy to use, it takes a moment to completely adhere to your skin, but after a few minutes it stays put. You can easily cut it to customize to your face and make it lay better around the nose.

avis.titre: All It’s Cracked Up To Be!
avis.texte: You can believe all the hype about this product because it really works! My skin has never been so soft or looked so glowing since I’ve been using this mask once a week. I use a little Witch Hazel as a toner before applying the mask and I’ve had great results. It stays put and doesn’t move around. I keep it on overnight and wake up to refreshed, glowing skin. I’m 82 years old and don’t have many wrinkles, (thanks to my mom’s genes), but after using this, the few that I do have are disappearing! This stuff is great!!

avis.titre: They worked for what I wanted.
avis.texte: My biggest thing that caused me to be self-conscious are the bags under my eyes. No matter what I did, they would not go away. After sleeping one night with the mask, they were gone, I mean, completely gone. The effects don't last though. Maybe a couple of days. Since the mouth and eye holes fall out as separate pieces, I keep those for nights when I am not using the entire mask so I can put them under my eyes. they are refreshing, but I don't know that I am finding a huge difference in my overall skin texture. They are expensive, so I can't use them every night (wish I could), but I will still be purchasing regularly. There is always serum left in the bottom of the pouch, so once I use a mask, the next night I will spread the serum on my face and under my eyes before bed, and again, save the mouth and eye holes to extend the life of the product a little bit.

avis.titre: Would buy this over and over again
avis.texte: Love using these face masks. My skin always feels great after 2 hours. It definitely makes me face fresh, glow, and moisturized.when you initially apply it on is tends to want to slide around but once you get in a right position it will start to form to your face and dry up a little. Once it turns clear it should be about done. Love it

avis.titre: Won't reorder
avis.texte: It's very refreshing but see nothing..... more hype than results. Been using for almost 2 months...... nothing...

avis.titre: Woke Up to Plump, Hydrated, "Glass" Skin — Incredible Overnight Mask!
avis.texte: I tried the Quasi Bio-Collagen Overnight Face Mask because I was looking for something to deeply hydrate my skin, and it delivered amazing results. The mask turns clear as your skin absorbs the ingredients, locking in moisture while you sleep. The next morning, my under-eye area and cheeks felt noticeably plumper, softer, and refreshed without any sticky or greasy residue. It helped soothe fine lines, smooth out rough texture, and gave my face an instant, healthy-looking glow that lasted throughout the day. It takes a little patience to let it set properly, but the results are completely worth it. If you want deep hydration and a spa-like treatment at home, I highly recommend giving this mask a try!

avis.titre: Very soft feeling.
avis.texte: Never tried a face mask before because I have sensitive skin but this mask feels so nice. I suggest you put it on laying down because it is very slippery and after awhile it sticks to your face. It’s very soft. Will write another review after the 2 hours

avis.titre: Did the job
avis.texte: Love this! Nice relaxing weird works fun different, look younger. 50s lookin 30.

avis.titre: Half a mask gets one star.
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this product until I opened my first packet and it only had one part of the mask. So my chin and cheeks didn’t get nothing. I felt cheated. 35.00 and my chin an jaw line gets no benefit. Where is the rest of my mask??

avis.titre: Not Sold on the Practicality
avis.texte: Prior to using these face masks, I was not familiar with PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide), which are DNA fragments derived from the sperm cells of certain fish, like salmon. I read up on the concept of using PDRN, and found that there is ample research to support using it to stimulate collagen production, improve skin texture, and reduce fine lines and wrinkles, depending on the strength of PDRN used. After washing my face and applying toner, I put on the rather slippery, two-piece PDRN collagen mask. The texture of the mask is like thin silicone. The instructions state that the mask should be left on for one and a half to two hours. So this was definitely meant for use in the evening for me. As I was lying down while wearing the mask, it did not slide off my face. I found that I had to tug it a little to adequately cover the sides of my face, my forehead, and under my chin. After removing it two hours later, I massaged the remaining serum into my skin. I can say that the mask was not irritating to my skin; no burning, redness, or itching. My skin definitely felt smoother, but I suspect that the true impact of the PDRN will require additional mask treatments, because I did not see any improvement in the fine lines on my forehead. Nor did I notice a 'glow'. As it was, since I applied it right before bedtime, a glow would not have mattered. And if I had applied it for two hours early in the morning before work (and who has time for that), a glow would not have been apparent under

avis.titre: I like it
avis.texte: It took me more than 2 1/2 hours for the mask to get clear. I love the shine on my skin; I wash my face, put some serum and place the mask. I place that little piece the I think it’s for the eyes in my lips, to see how it works, and it was fine. I like it, even though the serum itch my skin at the beginning, and it’s from the same brand.

avis.titre: Very effective face masks
avis.texte: This is a good quality salmon PDRN mask set. It comes with 4 masks. The result of applying this mask is moisturized skin and a radiant complexion. salmon PDRN promotes skin regeneration and repair and has anti-inflammatory effect on the skin. I got this for my wife and she is very happy after using it. At a discounted price of $25.98 for 4 masks, this is not a cheap product though.

avis.titre: Eh. No difference.
avis.texte: Not at all what I expected. It was cool on my face and clear within 2 hours, but honestly I didn't see a difference. I still have 3 more, so maybe I did something wrong. So far? Not impressed. The advertisements are definitely fake.

avis.texte: Not impressed. I used two within four days and the only thing I noticed was that my faced looked oily and puffy. Unless you are skinny and don’t have a lot of deep lines in your face it isn’t worth the money.

avis.texte: So I was amazed when I seen that this mask would go from white to “clear” after all these Amazing minerals would be directly deposited into my skin. My mask Never turned clear even after 3 hours.

avis.titre: Great middle ground collagen gel mask
avis.texte: I am a skincare addict, especially when it comes to facial masks, so I tend to request almost any new mask that shows up on my recommended page. Another reason I chose this facial mask is that I have already tried the overnight version of a similar mask from this brand and had a good experience with it. Here is the overnight version I am referring to, which is shown in my photo: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FKCJMB75 This is the type of collagen gel mask that you leave on longer than regular sheet masks. In fact, the overnight version has become extremely popular lately (TikTok viral), and honestly, I understand why. The results can be impressive in terms of moisturization, and I have come to love this style even more during cold and dry winter months when my skin needs extra care (although my favorite ones are from another brand and cost almost twice as much). I think this one is a great option for people who want the benefits of hydrogel-style collagen masks but do not want to commit to an overnight mask that has become popular through influencers. In my opinion, this one sits perfectly between overnight masks and the typical 20–30 minute sheet masks. By the way, be careful when you take it out of the pouch because it might not be as durable as it looks, even though the sheet seems quite thick. Once you gently put it on your face and let it sit for a couple of mins, it does cling to the skin very well, so you can do normal activities for the next 2 hours without worrying abou

avis.titre: High-quality "Melting" Gel Mask – Be prepared for the 2-hour wait!
avis.texte: If you are looking for that glass-skin 'Korean Glow,' this PDRN mask delivers, but you have to be patient with it. Unlike a standard 15-minute sheet mask, this is a hydrogel style that requires a much longer wear-time to fully absorb into the skin. Texture & Application: The mask has a cooling, gel-like consistency that feels much more premium than paper masks. It comes in two pieces (top and bottom), which makes it a lot easier to fit around a beard or different face shapes. It sticks surprisingly well; I was able to sit up and work on my computer without it sliding off. The Experience: I wore this for about 2 hours as recommended. You can actually see the mask getting thinner and more transparent as your skin 'drinks' the collagen and PDRN. Results: Immediate: My skin was noticeably more hydrated and had a genuine glow that lasted into the next morning. Comfort: It’s fairly comfortable, though after 90 minutes you definitely feel it 'tightening' a bit as it dries down. Verdict: This is a 'Sunday afternoon' mask, not a 'get ready for work' mask. It’s a commitment, but the hydration level is significantly deeper than cheap drugstore alternatives. No messy serum dripping down your neck. Two-piece design for a better fit. Visible results in skin texture and brightness. Long time commitment (1.5–2 hours). Can be a bit slippery when first applying

avis.titre: Very hydrating mask, fit well
avis.texte: The Quasi Salmon PDRN collagen mask was a really great experience! The mask is made of a soft material soaked in the serum. It is very well cut for your face and it worked better than others I have tried. I had to let it start to dry while I was laying down for about 10 to 15 minutes so it would stay in place and not keep slipping down. Once it was in place I was able to move around while I enjoyed my face mask. I kept mine on for 2 hours and it was about 75% dried when I removed it. My face felt really nice, soft and hydrated. I did not put anything else on my face until the next day to see how it would feel hours later and my face still felt amazing. This is a nice mask to use and I really enjoyed using it. There was no scent to it and my skin did not react negatively to it at all. I think these 4 masks are a great value and made my face feel wonderful. They are easy to use (for face masks soaked in serum!) and made my skin feel like wonderful. Designed in Korea and made in China

avis.titre: Cooling and relaxing masks!
avis.texte: The Quasi Salmon PDRN Collagen Mask is fairly easy to apply, though it can be a bit slippery when you first take it out. It comes with three extra pieces, two for the eyes and one for the lips. I like to place the eye pieces under or above my eyes on my brows, then apply the main mask over them. It feels cooling and soothing on the skin, and once it’s on, I usually relax for about 20–30 minutes. After each use, my skin feels soft, smooth, and well hydrated. I especially enjoy using it in the evening before bed, as my skin looks noticeably more dewy and refreshed by morning. It’s perfect for a quick skin boost before makeup or as a relaxing self-care treat.

avis.titre: Hydrating mask that feels gentle on skin. Not made in Korea
avis.texte: These gel masks are very saturated and feel soothing when applied. They did not sting my skin at all and left my face feeling well hydrated and smooth after use. My skin felt comfortable and refreshed, not tight or sticky. One thing to note is that despite being marketed as Korean skincare, these are not made in Korea. That said, the quality is still good, and getting four masks in one box makes this a nice value. They work well if you want an easy hydration boost without irritation.

avis.titre: Most frustrating gel masks to use, ever.
avis.texte: Where should I even start... I'm usually a fan of gel masks, and I'm definitely a fan of Kbeauty skincare and PDRN products. First, these are marketed as Kbeauty skincare, but they're not made in Korea. The masks seem well-made and are quite a bit thicker than usual gel masks, but as a result, they slide. There was no way I could use these masks without lying down, so I wouldn't say it's easy to use. At some point, I was struggling to breathe because it kept sliding down and covering my nose and mouth. Okay, I could try using them lying down, and it was fine. The serum is hydrating and didn't cause any irritation for me. Note that the serum dries slightly sticky on top of the skin, so it doesn't work under makeup. Overall, I've had better. Comfort and ease of use do matter.

avis.titre: An honest review.
avis.texte: This hydrogel mask features a two-piece design (one for the top and another for the bottom half of the face) to ensure a contoured, snug fit. While the material provides excellent adhesion, it is quite delicate parlicularly for those of us with long nails. In other words, you should handle with care when removing it from the plastic backing to avoid accidental punctures or tears. Fortunately, any minor nicks or slices are purely cosmetic and do not compromise the mask’s effectiveness or quality. The primary reason why I got this mask is because salmon PDNR products are all over the place and I was curious about the hype. What I have learned through my own research is that it is highly effective for skin regeneration, though its results are most visible through professional treatments rather than OTC products. So with that in mind, I kept my expectations in check. Over-the-counter serums allegedly provide excellent surface hydration and brightening, but because the DNA molecule is large, it may struggle to penetrate deeply on its own. I happen to use caster oil as a carrier for most of my OTC serums and creams so I am hoping that if I follow up with that post-mask, over time I will have results similar to a professional treatment. At the moment, I have only tried one of the masks and here are my initial thoughts: It is cooling on the skin and stays that way for the duration of wear. The hydrogel masks I've tried in the past are the same. It does feel like it's a better quality

avis.titre: Very hydrating; designed in Korea but made in China.
avis.texte: Over the last year or so I’ve been getting into the sheet mask game, so when I saw these Quasi Salmon DNA PDRN Hydrolyzed Collagen Masks become available to order on my screen, I figured I’d give them a try. First things I noticed when I received this product was that the box came with a tamper seal and that both the manufactured and expiration dates were clearly printed on the box. This box was made in September of 2025 and has till September of 2028, so plenty of shelf life left in them. There are 4 individually packaged masks inside and the directions for applying are simple to follow. When I opened one packet to use the mask, it was obviously that the mask was drenched in serum. The mask pieces were sliding off their plastic backing when I tried pulling them out. Once I had the mask on my face, it stayed put rather well and gave my face a slight cooling sensation while wearing it. Directions say to leave it on my face for 1.5-2 hours (or until the pink mask turns clear), but I fell asleep while wearing it so it stayed on for over 4 hours. Once I pealed it off, my skin felt more moisturized and looked less pink than it did earlier. Maybe with continued regular use it could help with dark spots and pore minimizing. After all these good points, I have to bring up two things I wasn’t too keen on. For one, the price. Four masks for $30 USD seems rather high. Especially because of my second point. When I ordered this mask set, I was under the impression these were made in Korea

avis.titre: NICE COLLAGEN MASKS
avis.texte: Quasi Salmon PDRN Collagen Mask – Korean Skin Care Gel Face Mask: These Quasi Salmon PDRN collagen Mmsks are nice. I was curious about this pink collagen jelly mask and honestly loved how it worked for me. The texture is different from your usual sheet mask, more like a jelly that feels cooling when you put it on, which was super relaxing after a long day. It makes my skin feel hydrated and smooth, and fresh. I like it, but the price is very high for me. They are made in Korea. I surely recommend it.

avis.titre: Spendy but worthy
avis.texte: I have been using Korean face masks for years, and there are very few that disappoint. These masks have been good so far. While I am used to wearing marks that one applies for 15-20 minutes, quasi masks require patience and time because these are left on the face between 1.5-2 hours. After each use, my skin feels soft and hydrated and appears glowy. There is also plenty of essence leftover, which I do not let go to waste. Although I am not particularly picky about sheet masks, except for their causing allergic reactions/irritations, I give this product 4 stars because it is not officially from Korea. For the price, there are also other masks that provide similar results and are much more affordable, not to mention some consumers may not want to wear a mask for close to two hours. Lastly, compared to other Korean quasi masks, this one is not necessarily better, so while it is worth a shot, I will probably purchase less inexpensive ones.

avis.titre: Nice Results, but Requires Time to Use
avis.texte: This mask made my skin feel really nice after using it, and my face still felt good the next day. It didn’t irritate my skin at all, which is a big plus for me. I also like that the mask comes in two pieces, which makes it easier to apply and adjust. That said, this is definitely not a “do things while wearing it” type of mask. The instructions suggest leaving it on for 1½ to 2 hours, during which it slowly slides down. I put it on while sitting on the couch watching TV, and even then, I still had to adjust it occasionally. If you plan to move around, this probably isn’t the best option. Overall, it’s a nice hydrating mask with good results, but the price is a little steep for only four masks. If you have a couple of hours to relax and don’t mind staying still, this could be a good fit for your skincare routine.

avis.titre: Little pricey - leaves face soft and brighter
avis.texte: These masks are good quality, very hydrating, and soothing. There was a little smell to it that could bother some. They do slip a bit at first, so I had to sit back and relax for about 15–30 minutes before they fully adhered to my face. Once set, they stayed in place, and I could move around the house easily. I have sensitive skin and had no irritation at all. The masks were effective in leaving my face very soft and brighter. They are a little pricey, but you get 4 masks in the pack, which makes it feel like a nice self-care splurge.

avis.titre: A Mini Luxury Spa Treatment for Your Skin
avis.texte: I found this mask to be intriguing because I’d never used one with Salmon in the description. I like that it didn’t have so much product on in when I took it out of the package that it was dripping everywhere which usually causes slippage in other masks. It feels really soothing on the skin, and it felt so comfortable on me that I accidentally fell asleep in mine for about 5-6 hours and so it was really ready to come off. Lol. I was worried about it because you’re not supposed to have it on your skin that long, but I didn’t have any adverse reactions to it and as I put my hand to my face it, my skin felt softer and smoother after using it. Seriously softer and smoother. I’m happy I got it and will be using it once a week/every other week to make it last longer. I definitely recommend this.

avis.titre: I love these masks - skin feels great!
avis.texte: This was my first time using salmon masks so I was pleasantly surprised at the feel of the them - they are kind of thick and slimy. It says to keep them on for 1.5 to 2 hours until they become transparent so that was also new to me. It takes some time for the mask to stay in place so I would pick out a movie, lay back to apply the mask and watch my movie and it fit fine for the duration. The mask feels cool and moisturizing. It did not fall apart when putting it on and stayed on my face. After using this product the effective makes my skin feel hydrated and refreshed. It's a bit pricey for 4 that come in a pack but I think the quality is there.

avis.titre: Great product
avis.texte: These pore care and uneven skin tone care makes skin look firm and smooth is the first thing that caught my eye when I made this selection. I ended up putting these in the refrigerator before I use them. It felt like my skin was being moisturized as soon as I put it on the cool feel on my face after removing them from the refrigerator made me feel like I was in a spa. The quality and durability is wonderful. I would suggest you lay on your back put the mask on and just lay there and relax. If you are standing, they tend to slip, and that was my first experience using them. So lesson learned. It gives you the directions to cleanse your face and prep your skin without any toner or serum. Once you open the pouch, you removed the film from the mask. When you apply the mask, it recommends that you leave it on for 1.5 to 2 hours. That direction I completely overlooked. Only leaving it on for 15 minutes. Once I remove the mask, it still had some of the collagen on my face and I was just able to rub it into my skin. It does give you a pro tip to leave on the mask until it turns transparent. I did not have any reaction on my face. All I knew is that my felt face felt smooth. This will be a regular purchase for me in my upcoming orders. Mine was pink, and I had used the green one before and I was really excited to try this one. I know that it was formulated and designed in Korea and I really enjoy the products that are made in Korea. When you put on the mask, it gives you a room enough
